column1: # Link lab cases. One line per case, whitespace separated.
#   site       where the Mac stand-in is: away (behind away-router, across
#              the wan) or home (on the home LAN with the NAS)
#   home_nat   home router mapping: easy (endpoint-independent) | hard
#              (endpoint-dependent, random port per destination)
#   fwd_ctrl   home router forwards TCP 30193 (the control URL): on | off
#   fwd_udp    home router forwards UDP 41641 (the NAS node): on | off
#   hairpin    home router loops LAN -> public address back in: on | off
#   split_dns  home router's resolver answers the control name with the
#              NAS's LAN address (a "local DNS" entry): on | off
#   away_nat   away router mapping: easy | hard
#   cgnat      a carrier NAT behind the away router: off | easy | hard
#   nas_net    host (the NAS node in its own container on the NAS host's
#              network: JM_NET_NAS_NODE=container, server/docker-compose.link.yml)
#              | bridge (the NAS node in the Manager, behind the NAS's
#              Docker NAT: JM_NET_NAS_NODE=on, the layout before)
#   portmap    the home router answers NAT-PMP port-mapping requests: on | off
#   expect     the path we expect: direct | derp | fail (no connection)
# wan-down-boot is a sequence, not one setup (measure.py, run_wan_down_boot):
# the home's internet link goes down, the Manager restarts (a NAS booting
# after a power cut before the router has internet), the Mac at home
# connects, then the internet comes back and the Mac away connects. Its
# columns are the routers' switches; "expect" is the away Mac's path. With
# the node container (host) the Mac at home must connect directly.
# name              site home_nat fwd_ctrl fwd_udp hairpin split_dns away_nat cgnat nas_net portmap expect
direct-forward      away easy     on       on      off     off       easy     off   host    off     direct
hole-punch          away easy     on       off     off     off       easy     off   host    off     direct
hard-nat-relay      away hard     on       off     off     off       hard     off   host    off     derp
forward-hard-away   away easy     on       on      off     off       hard     off   host    off     direct
cgnat-away          away easy     on       off     off     off       easy     hard  host    off     derp
cgnat-away-forward  away easy     on       on      off     off       easy     hard  host    off     direct
home-hairpin        home easy     on       on      on      off       easy     off   host    off     direct
home-local-dns      home easy     on       on      off     on        easy     off   host    off     direct
home-no-hairpin     home easy     on       on      off     off       easy     off   host    off     fail
portmap-bridge      away hard     on       off     off     off       hard     off   bridge  on      derp
portmap-host        away hard     on       off     off     off       hard     off   host    on      direct
wan-down-boot       away easy     on       on      off     on        easy     off   host    off     direct
